speaker: james_burbage
text: I am at the yard door, and I am counting them as timber. I will not give you a number before the swan is up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Count them as timber, then. The swan is for noon, and the trumpet is for two.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The stage is twice the breadth of the Cross Keys. The comedy has grown, or it will look small, and I did not build a small stage.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It has grown. I am not rewriting it on the nail. I am walking the entrances.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Give me the length of it, Will. At the Keys I was in the straw in four strides. I will not be in the straw here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou hast the length. Find Berowne on it. I have Navarre, and Navarre feels the same boards.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sing it on the breath, Sam, not on the word. The word will come along.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I can sing it. My throat is clear. I am not going to croak.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: That is the word. I have it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou art sound, Sam. Do not swell it. Clear is enough.

speaker: john_sincler
text: The messenger comes in black. The King your father.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Slower in. Then nothing. Let the yard do the rest when there is a yard.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot is on the nail. He needs no padding to look like bad news. If he enters early I will say so.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Holiday crowds over the fields. I can see them from this door. Timber does not pay me a compliment, and I am not selling it a post.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let them come. I read two bills on the Bishopsgate post on my way up. The Rose has The French Doctor. We have the comedy. No author on either, and no sum on either.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The French Doctor can stay over the water. I want the hush when the black coat comes, and I want it in the afternoon, not in an empty yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The hush is for the house. The house is not this yard yet. I am not calling a number before the trumpet.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Again, Sam. On the breath.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: On the breath. I hear you.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: May I stand by the post until Master Garnish looks at me?

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Stand by the post. I will look at you when the messenger is due, and not before.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four words, Sincler, and then nothing. We will not explain the messenger to an empty yard.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Noon for the swan. Two for the trumpet. I have said the times. I have not said a crowd.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the nuts can wait for the afternoon. I am not making a picture of a shell.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Good. I have the boards. I will see thee at two, in the part.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Once more is enough, Sam. The word will come along, and it has.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Then I have nothing further. I am clear.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Clear is the whole instruction. Go and be quiet until the trumpet.
